comment: A floating docker goes anywhere in the window, the top bar included. At 1280 by 1024 the Minimap is placed at 500, 300. A drag of 285 up stands it at y 15, over the menu bar, where the Navigator is wanted. A window shrunk to 1200 by 900 and grown back leaves it there. A drag of 500 more up stops it at y 0, the window's top row, its whole title strip still in. The Window menu's show and the dialogs still open under the bar, which the suite beside this reads.
